description: Ministry of Wild Life and Forest Resources Conservation - Order to declare that the Area of State Land In Mannar District as the Wedithalathie Nature Reserve
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the exclusion of a defined area of land (168.556 hectares) from the "Wedithalathive Nature Reserve" and the redefinition of the reserve's boundaries. It contains detailed land descriptions, survey numbers, and tracing references, which are characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers related to land management rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
